answer: Sybil farms collapse when a laboratory slot cannot be cloned. Each applicant leases one numbered autoclave tied to one live key and grows a single serialized crystal. A registered spiral dislocation is written into the boule during the 14-hour soak. They then fire a locked 405-nm violet probe; the published diffraction fingerprint must match that spiral and the bay log. A reused bay, a copied crystal, or a spectrum missing the registered violet lines slashes the reagent bond and admits neither key.
